en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad Bin Usman, from Al Hajby,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding the Words of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic
[3:97] and Hajj to the House is incumbent upon the people for the Sake of Allah, (upon) every one who is able to undertake the journey to it.
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘That there happens to be for him what he can perform Hajj with it’.

He (the narrator) said, ‘I said, ‘ (what about) the one who is offered that, from which he can perform Hajj with, but he is too embarrassed from that, would he be from the ones who has the capacity to journey to it?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes. What is his matter that he is too embarrassed
, and even if he has to perform Hajj upon an amputated tailless donkey? So if he has to endure walking partly and riding partly, so let him perform Hajj’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hammad ibn ‘Uthaman from af-Halabiy who has said the following:
“This is about the words of Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious,
‘It is obligatory upon people from Allah to perform al-Hajj who has the way (are able) to do so.’ [3:97]
Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al- Salam, said, ‘What is ‘the way’?’ He (the Imam) then said, ‘It means that he must have the means to perform al-Hajj.’

I then asked, ‘If one is provided with all the means to perform al-Hajj but he feels shy, is he considered of the ones who have the way (are able) to perform al-Hajj?’ He (the Imam) said, ‘Yes, and why should he feel shy
even if he performs al-Hajj on a donkey whose nose, ears and tail are cutoff? Even if one needs to walk certain distance of the way and ride other parts one must perform al- Hajj.’”
